== English Virtual Original comparison ==
July and October set deploy cost by the number of Dark Side Force icons present and allow deployment to any system. The remaster prints fixed deploy 4, expressly allows deployment without presence or Force icons, and adds a fourth passenger. The three pilots, permanent pilot ability, both local Force icons and ship-docking persist.
